description: A master clock and metronome, giving a start pulse, twelve pulses to the beat and an audible click

params.text: Sets the tempo in beats per minute, 0 to 301
Sets the clock back to the first beat of the bar without stopping it; the lamp in it flashes on the first beat of every four
The lamp that flashes on every beat; pressing it does nothing
Starts and stops the clock; the lamp in it is lit while the clock runs

inputs.text: A rise here starts or stops the clock
A voltage here takes over from the BPM knob, 0V to 10V across 0 to 300 beats per minute

outputs.text: A 10V pulse twelve times a beat
An audible click, a loud one on the first beat of each bar and a quieter one on the other three
A 10V pulse when the clock starts and on every reset

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
